scientific_question: Can an identity-free train-derived head semantic coordinate expose compactness and composition missing from the existing count-only Ugi program without changing the frozen coarse program sequence?

policy.semantic_weighting: equal amine-family mass within exact coarse amine program
policy.sampling: one conditional categorical draw per attempt without rejection or retry

nonclaims: The semantic target contains only graph diameter and N/O count coordinates; it contains no product, component, family, graph, SMILES or fragment identity.
This artifact accesses source-adjudicated measured Ugi train products only and does not access calibration or held-out product structures.
This artifact performs no molecular generation, model training, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls or candidate selection.
A train-derived target distribution does not establish generated-molecule realism until a paired method-blind generation experiment passes the frozen promotion gates.
